interface.signature: def findString(N: int, K: int) -> str:

preconditions.description: N and K must satisfy the given constraints: N is between 1 and 4, K is between 2 and 9, and K^N is less than 4096.

postconditions.expression: all(substring in S for substring in [''.join(map(str, p)) for p in product(range(K), repeat=N)])
postconditions.description: The returned string S must contain every possible string of length N with characters from 0 to K-1 as a substring.

postconditions.expression: len(S) == min(len(s) for s in possible_strings if all(substring in s for substring in [''.join(map(str, p)) for p in product(range(K), repeat=N)]))
postconditions.description: The length of S must be the minimum possible among all strings that satisfy Q1.
